gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: Noto Sans Meetei Mayek has big, round lowercase eyes with a gap like a cracked bangle, modern and easygoing. Expose is the compressed, striking one; the body font is the one that opens up.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikakui: Clean, modern lines run through the text, with daylight showing in every curve. Noto Sans Mende Kikakui stands its lowercase tall under Expose, whose tight, compressed capitals look sharper beside it.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Tight and striking up top, then relaxed below. Expose packs its display letters close with a refined edge, while Noto Sans Meroitic lets you see through its c openings in a plain sans way.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-modi: Modern, and quick to get to the point. Expose keeps its heading compressed and sharp, then Noto Sans Modi carries the text onward with daylight inside every curve and little height difference between its capitals and lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mono: Compressed display type meets wide-spaced text. Expose is at its best when tight and striking, whereas Noto Sans Mono does its job with roomy letterspacing and tall, sturdy lowercase in a sans-serif.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-mro: Striking is the first word for Expose, its capitals and lowercase packed nearly level and refined. Noto Sans Mro sits beneath it as a plain sans, dense and tall through the middle, with generous entrances into each letter.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-multani: Noto Sans Multani is a modern sans-serif with a lofty x-height and an e that leaves a wide gap at its terminal. Beside Expose, whose display letters are compressed and refined, it feels like an exhale after a tight breath.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Almost no gap separates the lowercase from the capitals in Expose, giving it a compressed, striking pace. But Noto Sans Myanmar is the plain sans that takes over, with a heavy-looking text strip and a broad, welcoming c.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Expose compresses its letters into a striking, refined display with barely any pause between them. And Noto Sans Nabataean, a sans-serif, lets lowercase stand almost cap-tall, so a longer stretch of text keeps its wide-open s curves.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Contemporary and sharp, the heading in Expose pulls its display letters tight with barely a pause. Noto Sans Nag Mundari, a sans-serif, lets lowercase rival the capitals, with half-unwrapped c and s shapes that carry a longer passage easily.
